description: This Java class configures auto-configuration for the Acme loan module in a Spring Boot application. It sets up component scanning for specific packages and defines a bean for LoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorFactory that incorporates a default processor and a list of processors.

classes.name: AcmeLoanAutoConfiguration
classes.description: Spring Boot auto-configuration class for the Acme loan module, setting up component scans and a transaction processor factory bean.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorFactory
methods.description: Creates a LoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorFactory instance configured with a default processor and a list of processors.
